adql: SELECT source_id, solution_id, designation, ref_epoch, ra, dec, phot_g_mean_mag, duplicated_source FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source WHERE phot_g_mean_mag IS NOT NULL AND phot_g_mean_mag <= 5.5 AND ra IS NOT NULL AND dec IS NOT NULL AND duplicated_source = 'false' ORDER BY phot_g_mean_mag ASC, source_id ASC
attribution: Data from ESA's Gaia mission, processed by the Gaia Data Processing and Analysis Consortium (DPAC).
limitations: Context stars only; rows are not canonical Lumina catalogue entities.
Catalogue positions use the published Gaia reference epoch.
This selection is not a statement of naked-eye visibility.
This artifact is not a complete physical model of the night sky.
usage_purpose: All-sky bounded Gaia DR3 bright-star context for the Lumina Sky Finder.
